label: Suppress companies

headings.className: section-header-label section-header-label--rule block! border-b pb-3 text-c-1 responses-title--tree mt-3 mb-0 block! leading-[1.45] font-medium

paragraphs: Store a list of company domains to suppress — nobody at these companies is contacted. The suppress list is organization-wide: it applies to every AutoGTM campaign, running or not. Every email is checked against it right before it goes out, so an address added here stops a sequence that is already mid-flight, not just future ones. Matching is exact: a person by their email address (case-insensitive, but jane+crm@acme.com and jane@acme.com are two different entries), a company by its domain (the lead's company domain or the domain of its email address — acme.com does not cover eu.acme.com, list each domain you use). One call = one list, exactly like uploading one CSV: a list name that is already taken gets a (2) suffix rather than merging, and lists are independent. Delete a list you no longer want. Domains are normalized (https://www.acme.com/careers → acme.com), so two spellings of one company collapse into a single entry. Values that are not a domain come back as skipped. Subdomains are separate entries — acme.com does not cover eu.acme.com.
